requirements.evidence: The full contract is implemented: entities/entity_memberships migrations with both named unique indexes and the owner_seq generated column (database/migrations/2026_10_29_044040_create_entities_table.php:14-22, ...044041...:15-26), models/enum/factories (app/Models/Entity.php, EntityMembership.php, UserRole.php), both policies, CreateEntityWithOwner, CreateEntity (submit, protected uniqueSlug, retry, audit, session, redirect), Dashboard, switcher, navbar entry, routes and both locales. One edge is unhandled: a 255-character name that needs a suffix produces a slug longer than the 255-character column (app/Livewire/Entity/CreateEntity.php:77-84 vs migration :17).

conventions.evidence: Follows the project patterns: domain write in an Action with Gate::authorize (app/Actions/CreateEntityWithOwner.php:22-34), #[Validate] + $this->validate() (app/Livewire/Entity/CreateEntity.php:26,31), policies for every authorization (EntityController.php:23, Dashboard.php:16), generated reversible migrations, #[Fillable], existing layout/Blade components, and updated docs/CHANGELOG. It misses mandatory Livewire rule 6: current_entity is only aliased for initial requests (bootstrap/app.php:19-21) and never registered via Livewire::addPersistentMiddleware in AppServiceProvider.

security.evidence: Authorization is server-side everywhere (EntityPolicy/EntityMembershipPolicy, Gate::authorize in EntityController:23 and Dashboard mount:16), input is validated (CreateEntity:26), the model is #[Locked] (Dashboard:14), all output uses {{ }}, mass assignment is guarded with #[Fillable], and entity creation is rate-limited (CreateEntity:33-39). No exploitable path was found; the only gap is the non-persistent tenant middleware noted under conventions, and the Dashboard has no public actions to reach without it.

tests.evidence: Six new Pest files exercise the DB constraints and scopes (tests/Feature/EntityModelTest.php:48-71), policies (EntityPolicyTest.php), onboarding incl. required name, slug suffixing, soft-deleted/reserved slugs, insert-collision retry, bounded retry and throttle (CreateEntityTest.php:59-181), tenant dispatch, 403s, pick/audit and guest/unverified redirects (TenantSessionTest.php:27-169), switcher/navbar markup (EntitySwitcherTest.php), and the Livewire locked-property tamper (EntityDashboardTest.php:56-60).

simplicity.evidence: Small single-purpose classes; no service/repository layer; ResolveCurrentEntity centralizes the 0/1/N dispatch reused by /home and the dashboard (app/Http/Middleware/ResolveCurrentEntity.php:18-42), and CurrentEntity is a two-property scoped context. The extras (rate limit, reserved switcher slug) are minimal and directly protect the new endpoints.

readability.evidence: Clear names and small methods; non-obvious logic carries short docblocks (app/Actions/CreateEntityWithOwner.php:10-13, CreateEntity.php:73-87, ResolveCurrentEntity.php:20-25); no dead code, debug output or inconsistent style in the production files.

scope.evidence: Every file added or edited serves the task: models, migrations, policies, factories, Livewire pages, middleware/tenant context, routes, lang keys, tests, and the required database-schema plus business-rules/architecture/CHANGELOG sync. No unrelated refactors or out-of-scope features.

issues.explanation: The custom tenant/authorization middleware current_entity is only registered as a route alias for initial requests; no Livewire::addPersistentMiddleware(ResolveCurrentEntity::class) is registered, so Dashboard update requests skip tenant resolution and its 403 check, violating the mandatory Livewire rule 6.

The name may be 255 characters and uniqueSlug() appends -2, -3, ... without truncating the base, so a duplicate of a very long name yields a slug longer than the 255-character column and a database error on MariaDB that the unique-violation retry cannot handle.
The switcher title test only asserts the text that also appears in the heading, so it would still pass if the layout ignored the :title prop and the document title stayed wrong.

review.summary: The change builds the entities/memberships data model with DB-enforced single ownership, policies and factories, the tenant middleware/context, onboarding with collision-safe slugs, the switcher, navbar entry, dashboard, both locales, docs and extensive Pest coverage. It is complete and well tested, but the custom current_entity middleware is not registered as persistent for Livewire updates (a mandatory project rule, though the Dashboard currently has no actions) and the slug generator can overflow the 255-character column for very long duplicate names, so it needs changes before merging.
